_source: Nightly Integration Tests run 35461793558 (2026-09-19), reports-both-<shard> artifacts, *-results.xml.
_units: Minutes of pytest time per connector marker, summed across both graph legs. Both legs run in one job, so a shard's wall clock is roughly this total plus ~10 min of stack build.
_core_note: The `core` shard is not marker-split: it runs everything the connector shards do not name, plus the browser tests. Measured at ~52 min of work (34 min pytest across both legs, the rest Playwright) in the same run. Shown for reference; only the connector shards can be rebalanced by moving markers.

_caveats.local_fs: Arango leg inflated by a 240s timeout in test_tc_lfs_filter_001_excluded_extension_is_dropped (57s on Neo4j). Real figure is nearer 19 min.
_caveats.azure_files: Understated: all four tests errored at setup in this run. Expect it to grow once the nested-folder sync fix lands.
_caveats.sharepoint: Skipped in CI (no credentials), so it costs nothing today.
_caveats.zammad: Estimated, not measured: this suite is new. Sized from bookstack (12.1 min, 5 tests) plus Zammad's slower stack start and its wait for the search index.
